runtime_config.scope: Original-source per-point recognition checked at three known central thumb locations, one boundary fixture and a side negative. Original approved boundaries unchanged; boundary remains UNKNOWN. Not full cooked hull reconstruction or damage calibration.

evidence.noise_policy: no nonpad positive force exempted; observed no-contact entries exactly zero
evidence.force_min_policy: 0.08N operational detection threshold; real thumb pad fixture sustained 0.121-0.195N; not a fruit damage threshold
evidence.threshold_rationale: Known approved central PAD contacts include source distance 0.3764mm and normal mismatch 19.912deg; 0.5mm/25deg bounds these empirical correspondences. Same 0.5mm boundary-uncertainty exclusion retained: fixture03 is 99/99 UNKNOWN, not accepted as a positive. Known side remains zero PAD. No nonpad positive load exemption. Hold/support/fault criteria unchanged.

runtime_config.geometry_approval_status_note: Original approval JSON is an immutable historical geometry-only receipt. Its NOT_RUN/usable_for_training=false described the approval date, not this later runtime calibration. Geometry and boundaries remain byte-identical; only this separately versioned runtime contract permits calibrated use.
runtime_config.invalid_packed_point_policy: mark all digit channels UNKNOWN only for the affected named environment; forbid success; retain raw force repr; no abs or numeric-noise exemption

appended_clock.semantics: known episode age relative to fixed release timing; not a future outcome, contact age replacement or success signal
